title: Hai Mươi Bốn Giờ Trước Một Món Mua Không Cần Gấp

shots.voice: Cảm giác muốn mua thường mạnh nhất ở ngay lúc nhìn thấy món đồ.
shots.sceneText: A young Vietnamese person stands outside a warm boutique store window, looking at aesthetic ceramics and stationery on display with curious, tempted eyes.

qa.reason: Clean 2D boutique-window illustration, exactly one adult, plain ceramics, no material pseudo-text/signature/watermark visible.

failureHistory.reason: Visible pseudo-text / fake labels on shop-display objects; fails TEXT_POLLUTION.
visible artist/signature-like mark in the bottom-right corner.

previousFailure.reason: visible artist/signature-like mark in the bottom-right corner.

shots.prompt:
CLEAN FLAT 2D CARTOON EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION ONLY.
NOT a photograph. NOT realistic. NOT 3D.

Exactly one visible adult standing outside a simple ceramic shop window.
Inside the display: only plain unbranded ceramic bowls and vases.
Every object is completely blank.

IMPORTANT CLEAN SURFACE RULE:
No words.
No letters.
No numbers.
No labels.
No price tags.
No cards.
No packaging text.
No logos.
No signature.
No artist mark.
No watermark.
No glyph-like scribbles.
Keep ALL FOUR CORNERS and the ENTIRE BOTTOM EDGE completely blank.

Warm ivory background, muted sage clothing, warm wooden shelf, charcoal/sepia linework.
Simple hand-drawn 2D cartoon shapes.

shots.voice: Vấn đề thường không nằm ở chỗ mình không biết phải làm gì.
shots.sceneText: A person holding a shopping basket pauses in a peaceful store aisle, holding an item and thinking with mild hesitation.
shots.shortIntent: Pausing with basket in store aisle

qa.reason: One adult with basket in aisle; clean composition and semantics.

shots.voice: Vấn đề là giải pháp trong đầu thường lớn hơn năng lượng mình có trong một ngày bình thường.
shots.sceneText: A person sits peacefully at home in an armchair holding a warm cup of tea, resting in quiet contentment without unnecessary purchases.
shots.shortIntent: Resting peacefully at home with tea

qa.reason: One adult resting with tea; clean scene and anatomy.

shots.voice: Có thể chỉ là một món đang sale,
shots.sceneText: A person gently examines a handcrafted ceramic bowl on a wooden display shelf in a calm lifestyle shop.

qa.reason: One adult examining bowl; semantic and anatomy acceptable.

shots.sceneText: A small handcrafted ceramic dish and an elegant brass bookmark resting quietly on a polished wooden desk in warm morning light. Clean still-life composition.
shots.shortIntent: Ceramic dish & brass bookmark on desk

qa.reason: Clean 2D still life, zero people/body parts, ceramic dish and brass bookmark are visibly present. The open book is acceptable contextual support and does not contradict the core semantic intent.

failureHistory.reason: Still-life contract requires zero visible people, but a partial human arm/hand is visible.
image is photorealistic instead of clean 2D cartoon/editorial; expected a ceramic dish + brass bookmark still life, but output became a photographic bowl/cup + open book.

previousFailure.reason: image is photorealistic instead of clean 2D cartoon/editorial; expected a ceramic dish + brass bookmark still life, but output became a photographic bowl/cup + open book.

shots.prompt:

ZERO PEOPLE.
